blurb: Ski Daddy offers all-inclusive group ski trip packages including lodging, lift tickets, and ski rentals. They provide expert advice, planning support, and a custom group website for managing signups and payments. Their focus is on making group ski trips easy and affordable, primarily for groups of 20 or more.
extraNote: Deposits are non-refundable once paid · Final payment due 45 days before trip · Resorts only refund unused lift ticket days for injury/illness with doctor’s note and original ticket or credit voucher · Check-in usually at 4:00pm, check-out at 10:00am
